title: Deathcord SMP
description: The Deathcord SMP is a medieval RPG-style modpack that adds an overhaul of new things to the game.
body:
Ready To enbrace your Jurrney with a new advencher.

Welcome To Deathcord SMP modpack. A new Jurrney awaits you full of Exploration, combat, farming and Roleplay.

Deathcord Smp modpack has an rpg style tons of mods to explore, lore, combat, more. This modpack would be amazing to start with your Friends.

Also Remeamber Dont Fly To Close to the sun.....
